description: This Java source file defines a mock implementation of the Akka Persistence SnapshotStore, named MockSnapshotStorePlugin. It provides methods for loading, saving, and deleting snapshots, primarily for testing purposes, and uses Mockito for verification. The class is tailored for use within testing frameworks, including logging and simulated failures.

classes.name: MockSnapshotStorePlugin
classes.description: A mock implementation of Akka's SnapshotStore for testing purposes, providing async load, save, delete operations, with logging and failure simulation.

methods.name: doLoadAsync
methods.description: Loads a snapshot asynchronously, returning a dummy SelectedSnapshot wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: doSaveAsync
methods.description: Saves a snapshot asynchronously, logging the operation; returns a successful Future<Void>.

methods.name: doDeleteAsync (SnapshotMetadata)
methods.description: Deletes a snapshot based on metadata asynchronously, logs the operation, potentially fails if the persistenceId matches 'failDeleteSnapshot'.

methods.name: doDeleteAsync (String, SnapshotSelectionCriteria)
methods.description: Deletes snapshots based on persistenceId and criteria asynchronously, with failure simulation for specific persistenceId.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method was called with the specified persistenceId and maximum sequence number.

methods.name: matchesCriteria
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentMatcher to compare SnapshotSelectionCriteria with a maximum sequence number.
